description: Put one suite for one production script, both scoped to run://, at the head of testicle's queue, and stop the run going unless it is that one (its results untouched, its rows left flagged, the next run assembled fresh, as a top-10 fix does): the 🏃‍♂️ button's verb, and the one an agent uses to have its tests run first. Nobody but testicle starts runs: its one runner starts one suite process at a time, never two, the suite given the script when it is a general test, and its tests report themselves to testicle.set, its success for the script to suite.success. testicle, a test's title, runs the suite up to that test, the tests before it with it (the reporter's --test); left out, the whole suite. A suite and script already at the head is never put there twice. Answered at once with {started: true}, not waiting for the run. Refused not-a-production-script, not-a-suite or no-such-file.
